_comment: Product nouns that must read the same everywhere. Locked before translation
starts, not argued during it: divergent terminology across the app and the
web is the failure mode here, not missing strings.
`de` is null where the German reviewer still has to decide. Two of these are
the open question from the plan: 'Flashcards' is normal German usage, but
'Think questions' and 'pass' are not, so those need a real German noun.
German address form is du, everywhere, no exceptions. Decided 2026-08-28.
It is locked before translation because changing it later invalidates every
string the reviewer has already approved.

voice.en: Plain and direct. Sentence case. No filler, no em-dashes.
voice.fi: Kirjakieli, ei puhekieltä. Sentence case. Ei täytesanoja eikä ajatusviivoja.
voice.de: du throughout. Sentence case. No filler, no em-dashes. Say it the way a person who knows the subject would say it, not the way a manual would.
